component.name: OpenRapoo
component.summary: Configure extra buttons and features for Rapoo MT760 Pro mouse
Configure botões adicionais e recursos do mouse Rapoo MT760 Pro

description.p: OpenRapoo is a native open-source Linux utility designed to configure, remap, and manage extra buttons and profiles for the Rapoo MT760 Pro mouse.
O OpenRapoo é um aplicativo Linux open source nativo projetado para configurar, remapear e gerenciar botões adicionais e perfis para o mouse Rapoo MT760 Pro.

ul.li: Auto-detection of Rapoo MT760 Pro over 2.4 GHz, NearLink, Bluetooth, and USB
Remap extra side buttons and horizontal scroll wheel via evdev and uinput
Custom action categories: key combinations, media controls, terminal, macros, and commands
Hardware diagnostic tools and technical report generation

screenshot.caption: Main application window displaying detected Rapoo MT760 Pro mouse
Janela principal do aplicativo exibindo o mouse Rapoo MT760 Pro detectado

description.p: Initial release with diagnostic tools, evdev remapping daemon, and GTK4 GUI interface.
